# acanalab

> acanalab is a small European studio that makes calm, privacy-friendly iPhone apps. It offers creators and influencers their own fully branded daily affirmations iPhone app, published under the creator's own Apple account (Partner: no setup fee, the creator keeps 70% of net sales; Pay once: a one-time fee, the creator keeps 100%), and publishes its own apps, Daily Affirmations and HoneyNest.

## Own-brand affirmations app for creators and influencers

For content creators, influencers and coaches looking for an additional, passive revenue stream that fits a wellness, mindset, self-care or lifestyle audience.

- acanalab builds and publishes a finished daily affirmations iPhone app with the creator's name, icon and colors, under the creator's own Apple developer account. The listing, reviews and subscribers belong to the creator.
- No technical work for the creator. The creator needs an Apple Developer account ($99 a year, paid to Apple).
- Two plans. Partner: $0 upfront; the creator keeps 70% of net sales and acanalab 30%; updates free while acanalab's share averages $250 a month or more. Pay once: a one-time fee ($4,900 regular price; current offers on the homepage); the creator keeps 100% of sales; fixes free for 12 months, new features quoted separately.
- Income: subscriptions paid by Apple monthly. Net sales are what Apple pays out after its 15% fee (Small Business Program). Example: 500 subscribers at $7.99 a month is about $3,396 a month in net sales, so about $2,377 a month for the creator on Partner and $3,396 on Pay once.
- Includes the App Store listing, screenshots, subscriptions and paywall, privacy policy and terms, and Apple's review. No third-party ads, no tracking.
- iPhone first; Android later if the iPhone app does well. Today the app type is daily affirmations.
- A free brand picker shows the creator's app on real screens in a few minutes, with no sign-up: https://acanalab.com/design/
- Details, pricing and FAQ: https://acanalab.com/
- About acanalab: https://acanalab.com/about/
- Contact: support@acanalab.com

### Common questions, answered

- [How to launch your own affirmation app](https://acanalab.com/guides/how-to-launch-your-own-affirmation-app/): There are three ways: hire an agency or freelancer to build a custom app, build it yourself with a no-code app builder, or use a white-label service that brands a finished app for you. Every route needs an Apple Developer account ($99 a year), a name and icon, affirmation content, subscriptions, a privacy policy and an App Store listing, and the app must pass Apple's review. For creators with an audience, a white-label service like acanalab is usually the fastest route with no coding: you pick your name, icon and colors, acanalab builds and publishes the app under your own Apple account, and you earn from subscriptions every month.
- [How much does it cost to make an affirmation app?](https://acanalab.com/guides/how-much-does-it-cost-to-make-an-affirmation-app/): Every iPhone app pays Apple $99 a year for the Developer Program, and Apple keeps 15% of subscription sales for most small developers. Building the app is the big variable: a custom app from an agency or freelancer usually costs tens of thousands of dollars plus paid updates, a no-code builder costs a monthly subscription and your own time, and a white-label service can cost nothing upfront. With acanalab, the Partner plan is $0 upfront and acanalab takes 30% of net sales; Pay once is a one-time fee ($4,900 regular price) and you keep 100% of sales.
- [How much money can an affirmation app make?](https://acanalab.com/guides/how-much-money-can-an-affirmation-app-make/): It depends on subscribers, not downloads. Multiply subscribers by the monthly price and by 0.85 (what's left after Apple's 15% fee) to get net sales. At $7.99 a month, 200 subscribers bring in about $1,358 a month in net sales, 500 about $3,396 and 1,000 about $6,792. On acanalab's Partner plan the creator keeps 70% of that (about $951, $2,377 and $4,754 a month); on Pay once the creator keeps all of it. No one can honestly guarantee income: it depends on your audience and how you share the app.
- [Branded app for creators: acanalab vs agency, freelancer and app builders](https://acanalab.com/guides/branded-app-for-creators-compared/): An agency or freelancer gives you the most freedom but costs the most and takes months. A no-code builder is cheaper, but you do the building, testing and App Store submission. Course and community platforms offer apps built around their own content. acanalab is built for one job: a finished daily affirmations app for iPhone with your name, icon and colors, published under your own Apple account, with $0 upfront on Partner (you keep 70% of net sales) or a one-time fee on Pay once (you keep 100%).

Formula and Examples](https://acanalab.com/guides/how-much-money-can-an-affirmation-app-make/): How much an affirmation app can earn: a simple formula, earnings from 50 to 2,000 subscribers at $7.99 a month, how to estimate subscribers from followers and what makes the number grow.

## Daily Affirmations (iPhone app)

A free iPhone app with fresh positive affirmations every day, streaks, gentle reminders, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, favorites with an on-device AI take (Apple Intelligence) and shareable cards. Free with no time limit; Premium adds widgets, up to 30 affirmations a day, every category, every card style and unlimited favorites. It is also the live example of the creator app.

- App page: https://acanalab.com/dailyaffirmationsapp/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809586170

## HoneyNest (iPhone app)

An iPhone app for couples to track shared expenses together: log who paid, see who spent what, and stay in sync via iCloud.

- App page: https://acanalab.com/honeynest/
